messages:
noah: Need a crisp benchmark narrative for next week's launch: focus on latency vs unit cost, one social card + interactive demo + inbound routing. Ideas?

iris: Keep it simple: one visual that answers two Qs — how much faster, and how much cheaper across model options. Use concrete numbers (median/p95/p99 and $/1k).

omar: I'll design a scatter + small CDF inset. Scatter: x=median latency, y=cost/1k with model clusters; add iso-cost curves and a toggle for cache on/off. CDF to show tail improvement with batching.

tess: Copy angles: short social hook, landing explainer, and webinar blurb. My drafts: social: "Latency vs cost: which side is your app on? See real tradeoffs -> [link]" landing title: "Make latency predictable without overspending" webinar: "Live: real workloads, caching, and batching in production."

noah: Routing: three flows — self-serve demo, platform AE, enterprise security review. Use utm_segment and internal bench tags for HubSpot. Track interactive-chart engagement as high-intent.

omar: Deliverables: PNG 1200x628, interactive Vega spec, small gif showing cache on/off. ETA Thursday EOD.

iris: I'll hand off landing copy + 2-line in-product banner copy by Wednesday.

tess: I'll prep A/B test variants for social copy 1 vs 2 and landing headline 1 vs 2. Goal CTR to demo >= 7%.

noah: Perfect. Key narrative: concrete numbers, clear CTA (estimate/demo), segmented inbound flows. Tag #assets when done.
